items.title: Emu Concept – Make AI Follows Your Rules. (Feedback Wanted)
items.raw_excerpt: The idea is how can we make personal agent apps on the phone just listen to your rules... Like it's weird to have Muse, Grok Bot, Dots, Instinct not ask me about when I want them to work for me or align with my rules, values, and goals. If I give these agents access to tools/connectors/data they just "assume" what I want or what it should do rather than asking me? And even if I set these for a specific agent then what happens when a newer personal agent comes out? Do I have to reconfigure again my rules for each flavor of personal agents or harness? This is where our initial idea stems from and we need feedback: Emu is a self-learning on-device AI guardian that makes AI agents follow your rules. Also the video above kind of just highlights Emu's concept thought process.

items.title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
items.raw_excerpt: Enterprise leaders want AI agents to take on more work but don't fully trust them to act correctly every time. Trust in Depth is AWS's layered approach-scope, know, bound, observe, and prove-that lets agents act on their own when their actions can be verified, reserving human judgment for the decisions that need it.

items.title: 海康威视亮相2026中国工博会：物联感知+AI，加速工业场景数字化
items.raw_excerpt: 10月12日-16日，2026年中国国际工业博览会在上海举办。海康威视以“物联感知+AI，加速工业场景数字化”为主题，携面向质量检测、设备监测、生产运营、安全生产等核心环节的100余款场景数字化产品亮相工业自动化展（IAS2026），并发布十余款新品，带来海康威视在工业领域的创新探索与实践，展示物联感知、AI大模型为工业场景带来的真实改变。       展区含“AI”量十足 加速工业场景数字化   中国拥有最全的工业门类，也拥有全球最丰富、最复杂的工业场景，不同行业、不同生产模式和不同制造工艺差异明显。要推动工业由大到强升级，场景数字化是关键抓手。“数字化是工业智能化的基础，工业场景的数字化是一个持续的过程，尽管有些场景已经数字化了，但仍需要实现更多要素、更高质量的数字化，以进一步提质、降本、增效，提升核心竞争力。”海康威视相关负责人表示。   面向万千的工业场景，海康威视持续拓展了可见光、红外、毫米波、X光、声波等全面的感知技术，并依托海康观澜大模型“多、快、准、省”的系统性优势，加速工业场景数字化升级，助力用户解决实际场景中的具体问题。本届工博会上，海康威视展出的系列大模型产品与解决方案，为解决工业领域的诸多具体问题提供了新解法，既能破解行业悬而未决的"老问题"，也能帮助攻克制造升级中产生的"新课题"。   现场展出的大模型产线行为SOP检测方案，是用AI大模型破解行业"老问题"的典型应用。面对制造业产线换产频繁、工序操作行为难管控、AI部署成本高等长期痛点，该方案自带开箱即用的常见产线算法，生产现场实时呈现操作情况，异常即时报警并指导工人纠正；面对新工件、新场景，仅需1-8张图片即可注册生成新模型，实现分钟级部署；搭配零代码编排软件与LA客户端，轻松

items.title: Local and Distributed Large LLM Inference with MLX and RDMA on Mac Studio
items.raw_excerpt: MLX on Mac with Apple silicon lets AI researchers and developers experiment locally with the latest models and methods in a private environment. The open-source array framework leverages the unified memory architecture of Apple silicon, enabling anyone to run new inference and fine-tuning methods on their own hardware and explore other AI techniques. In a previous post , we highlighted the advantages of the M5 architecture and its GPU Neural Accelerators.

items.title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
items.raw_excerpt: Multimodal agents commonly generate freeform reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. items.title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
items.raw_excerpt: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry.
